decisions.why: 'Healthcare professional' is a channel label, so judged on products: AirCurve 11 ST and ST-A (bilevel), Airsense 11 Elite and Airsense 11 CPAP are positive-airway-pressure therapy devices - respiratory therapy & circuits, consistent with every other ResMed PAP division already mapped. 'Home sleep testing solutions' is the single diagnostic outlier.
